caption:
What's coming next from Samsung? Galaxy Unpacked on July 22!

Samsung's next Galaxy Unpacked event is scheduled for July 22 in London. The company has confirmed that it will introduce its latest Galaxy innovations that build on its leadership in foldables.

The event is expected to feature an updated family of foldables, including possibly two versions of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and a new Galaxy Z Flip 8. The new foldables are rumored to include a reworked hinge, improved performance, and a lighter chassis.

Additionally, Samsung may also unveil updates to its Galaxy Watch line and possibly its upcoming Android XR glasses. Reservations for the new devices are now open, with a $30 credit for pre-orders.
